QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] A Lone Tree
QuestInfo.0: You arrived in heart of the forest, but things are not going your way. Talk to the Small Spirit.
QuestInfo.1:
Once again, the Wind Spirit appears with an important clue.
Talk to the #rWind Spirit#k in #b#m450005200##k for details.
QuestInfo.2: According to Wind Spirit, one of the Tree Spirits is lost deep within the forest.

0.msg: Phew. It seems like you did something to anger the Tree Spirits. Maybe they don't like the way you look...? Anyway, what do we do now?

1.msg: (The Tree Spirits think I took their friend.)

2.msg: Oh, no! One of the Tree Spirits is missing? What's going on?\r\nI hope they're all right...

3.msg: #b(You hear a breeze whoosh through the nearby trees.)#k

4.msg: I saw a Tree Spirit, while I was whizzing and wooshing. All by his lonesome... One can't help but worry.

0.msg: Hum-di-dum-dum~ Little Tree Spirit, wandering alone~\r\nDo you think it was playing Hide-and-Seek?

1.0: I saw that Tree Spirit somewhere in the forest's heart.
1.1: Deep, deep in, under the trees! I'm not sure where exactly...
1.2: Trees and trees and trees. Everywhere I go looks the same~

0.msg: #b(With that, the Wind Spirit soared off once more on the breeze.)#k

1.msg: Well, the Tree Spirit is lost and wandering deep in the forest. But we have no idea where it is...

0.msg: #b(You should ask the Wind Spirit what he knows.)#k
